addOns.description: $12.00 + tax per person, Monday to Sunday. Passengers pay the regular price.

faq.q: Is there a height requirement to drive the go-karts?
faq.a: Must be 58″ or taller to drive go karts. Go Kart passengers must be at least 40 inches tall (regular price applies to passengers). Anyone driving a passenger must be 18 years or older or the child's guardian.

faq.q: Can we swap attractions in a group package?
How big a group can you host?
faq.a: Rent a private room for a group of 15 or take over the entire complex for up to 1,000.

faq.q: Are drinks like beer and wine available for groups?
faq.a: Want Beer & Wine Service? Ask us about the group alcohol rate!
